column1: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Toss the turkey neck, carrots, celery, and onion with the oil, salt, and pepper and roast 30–40 minutes until deeply browned.
Transfer everything to a stockpot. Add the stock, bay leaf, thyme, and rosemary and simmer gently for 1 hour.
Melt the butter in a separate pot, whisk in the flour, and cook 8–12 minutes, stirring constantly, until light brown.
Strain the stock, discard the solids, and whisk in the roux until smooth.
Strain again for a silky finish. Stir in the Boss Blend and fresh thyme, then taste before adding more salt and pepper.
